mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases the cost of capital and pressures equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (above 5.0%) and elevated CPI index (above 310) indicates a persistent inflationary environment with restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, an unemployment rate above 4.5% signals an unexpected labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level above 158 million indicates a robust labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above 158 million, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1200 thousand units indicates weak consumer demand and a decelerating economic cycle, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low housing starts (below 1200 thousand units) and weak residential sales (below 700 billion dollars) indicates a severe housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) indicates a severe manufacturing contraction that disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and the regime is supply shock, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
